title: HF284 (2025-2026 Regular): Information collected and scope of background check conducted expanded for noncitizen permit to carry applicants.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-02-10; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/HF/284/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced 2025-02-10. Section 1 also strikes an "and" and a period to fit the new clause (7). The check is part of the permit background check, so not treated as a deportation topic.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): (7) if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the applicant's country of birth and alien number or alien admission number.
Section 2 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 4): In addition, if the applicant is not a United States citizen, the sheriff must ensure that an Immigration Alien Query (IAQ) check is performed on the applicant.
